# Verified skills

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_verified_tier.py from audit/verified-tier/trigger_results.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**152 of the 389 skills we tested loaded on every plain-language test prompt and stayed quiet on the unrelated one.** Install any of them and Claude Code picks it up when you describe the task in your own words, without naming the skill.

A skill whose description doesn't match how people ask for help sits installed and unused, and few skill libraries publish whether theirs load. We measure it, and CI blocks a new skill that loads on fewer than half of its test prompts.

## How we test

- Claude Code 2.1.317, model `sonnet`, only the skill's own plugin installed.
- Each skill gets positive prompts written the way a user would ask, without the skill's name, and one negative prompt that is close but should not load it.
- **Verified** means every positive prompt loaded that exact skill and the negative prompt loaded nothing.
- The latest measurement wins. Measurements used:
  - `sweep-2026-11-03`: 2 positive prompts + 1 negative, 1 run
  - `heldout-2026-11-03`: 2 held-out positive prompts + 1 negative, 1 run, on the rewritten descriptions
  - `blind-2026-11-03`: 2 blind positive prompts + 1 negative, 2 runs each (live description: the 14 kept rewrites, old text for the rest)

Two prompts per skill is a small sample, so read this as a strong signal rather than a guarantee. A skill missing from this list may still work when you ask for it by name.

## Install

```bash
/plugin marketplace add alirezarezvani/claude-skills
/plugin install <plugin>@claude-code-skills
```
